# Chapter 22 – Mold

Scene 1. A fungal bloom spreads through one section of the greenhouse.

Scene 2. Mei walks Gabriel through why closed habitats fear biology in both directions: you need microbes and plants to help you live, but the wrong growth can ruin food and air systems.

Scene 3. Half a crop cycle is sacrificed.

Scene 4. Tempers flare over sterilization protocols and labor demands.

Scene 5. Mei realizes she needs more support from utilities and medicine, not less. Bridge: Biology forc
